author: Minecraft
description:
Your community has big plans. Give them a place to build with Minecraft Realms Pro! Host up to 50 players at once on our most powerful private server yet, with easy setup, advanced admin controls, and real-time collaborative editing on PC. Build sprawling towns, run mini-games, or gather your community for an adventure. Agreeing on where to build? That's still up to you.* 

*Requires Minecraft: Bedrock Edition (sold separately) and internet (ISP fees may apply). Play on console requires a platform specific online subscription (sold separately). 50-player limit subject to device performance limitations. Game performance might be impacted by high numbers of simultaneous players in low-end performance devices. Minecraft Editor is only available on PC platform, via Minecraft: Bedrock Edition for Windows (sold separately).
title: Introducing Minecraft Realms Pro

author: Minecraft
description: POWCreations is putting on a show! Watch as your favorite creators go head to head in various POW themed challenges. From Rats, Pirates, Cowboys and more... Watch LIVE as they compete for the ultimate prize!
title: The POW Show: Challenges & Trivia

author: Minecraft
description: Venture deeper into the Sift dimension as Minecraft Dungeons II takes to the stage for a deep-dive into its next chapter! Join Mojang devs for live gameplay run, closer look at upcoming features, and challenges awaiting on the horizon.
title: Minecraft Dungeons II: Surprise Showcase

author: Minecraft
description: Watch 4 of the best Minecraft Speedrunners face off in an ice cool tournament to show how fast players can "Free the End" when racing head to head. Join Feinberg, Infume, Silverrruns and Aquacorde for a brr-illiant showdown!
title: Frostbite Invitational: A Minecraft Speedrunning Tournament

author: Minecraft
description: The Mid-Offs is taking on San Diego! The biggest Minecraft speedrunning tournament is back. Watch as top speedrunners coach your favorite creators' skills to the limits in front of a LIVE audience. You don't want to miss this one.
title: The Mid-Offs: LIVE AGAIN

author: Minecraft
description: Minecraft's deadliest players take on San Diego on the Minecraft Stage! Join the Lifesteal SMP as they play in a fast-paced Lifesteal Quiz Show hosted by Pangi - quickly jumping into a Q&A hosted by Ashswag where they answer YOUR most burning questions about Lifesteal and more.
title: Lifesteal Quiz Show + Q&A

author: Minecraft
description: Your favorite creators. Your favorite Minecraft PvP Client. One unforgettable showdown! Join Lunar Client and some of the biggest names in Minecraft as we dive into the past, present, and future of competitive PvP. Then, watch your favorite creators go head-to-head in a LIVE PvP showdown, where a spin of the wheel determines the game mode, the matchups are unpredictable, and bragging rights are on the line. We'll see you in San Diego - don't miss out!
title: The Lunar Client PvP Panel & LIVE Showdown

author: Minecraft
description: Competitive Minecraft is growing faster than ever through speedrunning, PvP, and events—but women remain underrepresented in a lot of these spaces. In this panel, creators who compete at the top level discuss the challenges they've faced, how they've navigated the competitive scene, and what it'll take to make it more welcoming. If you want to understand the barriers and help build a better space for the women who come next, this conversation is for you.
title: Women in Competitive Minecraft panel
